Agents saw no grades, no key, no original filenames; the label join happened strictly afterwards, outside any model request. Reliability is supported by unanimity, by 10/13 totals matching the independently produced grades.csv, and by the owner verification below — but rows not covered by owner verification remain agent-read, not human-read.

grade_discrepancy_investigation.summary: 3 of 13 official grades are inconsistent with the physically marked answer sheets: scan 05 official 50 vs sheet-faithful 40 (+10), scan 06 official 70 vs 60 (+10), scan 13 official 30 vs 40 (-10).
evidence: All 130 rows were read 2/2 unanimous by two blind readers; every score-relevant row was additionally spot-verified on the crop images (scan 06 rows 6/7, scan 13 row 10) — clean single marks, no corrections.
The four key columns are pinned by the 10 exactly-matching exams (heart: 02=60, 30=20; spade: 28=50; diamond: 15=70, 21=80, 24=30; club: 29=50, 32=40, 36=50, 37=30).

Direct booklet re-derivation from source: heart booklet (scan 06) Q6 prints 271=alef, sol marks 271 correct => heart[6]=A confirmed; heart Q5 4/19=bet confirmed; spade booklet (scan 13) Q9 0.027=gimel and Q10 8.33=bet confirmed against sol page 3.
Exhaustive single-cell key-edit search: no cell change reconciles any of the three exams without breaking an exactly-matching same-suit exam.
Universal question-credit (appeal/throw-out) theories also fail: crediting any question that would lift 05 or 06 would also lift 02 or 30, which match exactly.
grade_discrepancy_investigation.conclusion: grades.csv totals for scans 05, 06, 13 do not follow from the marked sheets under any consistent key; most plausibly instructor totaling/transcription errors (each exactly one question, +/-10). Benchmark metrics are therefore reported against BOTH grades.csv (official) and the audited sheet-faithful totals.

owner_verification.statement: The project owner manually checked exams 05, 06, and 13 and confirmed the grader totals (40, 60, 40) are correct and that grades.csv is wrong for those three exams.
owner_verification.scope: Upgrades the three grades.csv-discrepancy findings from inference to owner-confirmed fact. Other exams/rows: agent-read, cross-checked against grades.csv totals (10/13 exact).
